capabilities: capture photos with the Android camera and embed them at the cursor
compress images with presets or expert controls (quality, size, format, EXIF)
save photos to a configurable folder, optionally organized by year and month
browse, search, sort, and reuse saved photos in a gallery
rename, preview, insert at set width, or delete photos from a context menu
extras: Photo capture only works on Android; the gallery, context menu, and drag-and-drop also work on desktop; iOS is unsupported. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to take photos with a device camera and insert them into notes with configurable compression and storage.
summary: Android camera capture plugin that compresses photos, embeds them in notes, and includes a gallery for browsing and reusing saved images.
